critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.description: Column name mismatch between growth history dictionary and preprocessor schema causes all mother-entered feeding (breastfeeding, formula, solids) and illness symptoms (diarrhea, fever, cough) as well as child demographics (DOB, gestational age, birth length, delivery type, APGAR) to be silently dropped and replaced with median/zero imputation.
critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.evidence: growth.py format_history_for_ml uses 'currently_breastfeeding', 'solid_foods_started', 'diarrhea_last_14_days' whereas baseline_feature_metadata_v1.json expects 'breastfeeding_status', 'complementary_feeding_started', 'diarrhea_recent'.

critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.description: Selected research architecture (90% XGBoost + 10% Clean Transformer) is not implemented in production service. Backend only loads and executes XGBoost.
critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.evidence: model_loader.py has get_risk_model() loading xgboost.joblib. No loader for final_transformer_clean.keras or sequence_preprocessor_v1.joblib exists.

critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.description: services/child-growth-monitoring-service/requirements.txt lacks tensorflow or keras. If Clean Transformer loading code is executed in Docker, it will throw ModuleNotFoundError.
critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.evidence: child-growth-monitoring-service/requirements.txt only lists xgboost, shap, scikit-learn, joblib.

critical_bugs_and_inconsistencies.description: Main landing dashboard (/app) has disabled buttons for 'Growth Monitoring' and 'Add Measurement' with placeholder text 'Available in Stage 16C', blocking users from accessing existing features through the main dashboard cards.

Risk score is displayed as an uncalibrated probability percentage (e.g. 23%) despite explicit manifest warnings that scores are ordinal ranking indices. In addition, backend uses arbitrary threshold 0.50 instead of locked research threshold 0.064055.
